How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JIPMER Project Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Project Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 29 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in Science or relevant subjects with 3 years of experience, or a Master's degree in the relevant subject, or a Pharm D. A Master of Public Health Degree is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Assistant position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Project Technical Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the JIPMER Project Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month for the duration of the contract.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Assistant position in this JIPMER recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis. Candidates will be appointed for a specific period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job is located in Puducherry, at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER).
